elements.name: problem
elements.text: Soft skills matter in engineering education. This project investigates whether interview language and vocal delivery can support their estimation, using personality as an intermediate step.

elements.name: question
elements.text: Can LLM-derived text cues and audio characteristics predict interview ratings and support an exploratory Big Five-to-BESSI skill mapping?

elements.name: objective-list
elements.text:
1. Extract structured language and audio features.
2. Compare predictions with simple baselines and published RecruitView results.
3. Evaluate a separate personality-to-skill mapping and identify its limits.

elements.name: limits
elements.text:
Limits: no direct BESSI labels in RecruitView; emotion cues lack independent validation; engineering-student generalisation is untested.
Follow-up test analyses are exploratory. Research use only; do not use these estimates for hiring decisions.
